subtitle: Lesson 5 · SOQL Fundamentals

code:
SELECT Id, Name, Industry,
       AnnualRevenue, BillingCity
FROM Account
WHERE Industry = 'Technology'
  AND AnnualRevenue > 1000000
ORDER BY AnnualRevenue DESC
LIMIT 25
caption: Picklist values must match your org exactly.

code:
SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName,
       Email, Title, AccountId
FROM Contact
WHERE Email != null
  AND AccountId != null
ORDER BY LastName, FirstName
caption: AccountId is a lookup: it stores the parent Account's Id.

code:
SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject,
       Status, Priority, CreatedDate
FROM Case
WHERE IsClosed = false
  AND Priority = 'High'
ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC
LIMIT 50
caption: IsClosed is safer than listing every open Status.
